description: Infrastructure Monitor is the Global Infrastructure Hub's flagship report on global trends in private investment in infrastructure, with accompanying data insights and policy articles. The 2024 edition, the fifth and the first released as part of the World Bank, analyses private investment in infrastructure projects in primary and secondary markets, the financial performance of infrastructure debt and equity, blended finance, infrastructure funds and ESG factors, using data aggregated from leading infrastructure databases; data insights cover topics such as green investment by income group, local-currency deal shares and net zero targets of infrastructure assets. It is produced by the Global Infrastructure Hub. The report chapters, executive summary PDF, data insights and prior year reports are available free on the GI Hub website; no licence is named. Caveats: figures are aggregates of data from other infrastructure databases, and the pages present charts and analysis, not a transaction-level dataset. It supports investment appraisal and scenario work on infrastructure finance across sectors; a related record is the ASCE Report Card.
